services_subhead: We handle everything from interior redecorating and exterior painting to specialist finishes and property preparation.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Transform your living spaces with expert wall and ceiling finishing. We prep, prime, and paint to deliver flawless colour and long-lasting results.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's façade with weather-resistant exterior paint. We handle woodwork, masonry, and cladding with care and precision.

services.title: Feature Walls & Wallpaper
services.desc: Create visual impact with professionally applied feature walls or quality wallpaper. Perfect for accent rooms, hallways, or complete makeovers.

services.title: Cabinet & Furniture Painting
services.desc: Breathe new life into tired kitchen cabinets, doors, and bespoke furniture. Our specialist finishes resist daily wear and deliver showroom-quality results.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: From offices to retail spaces, we deliver on schedule and within budget. Minimal disruption, professional finish, comprehensive site care.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Poor prep ruins the best paint job. We strip, sand, fill, and prime properly so your finish lasts years, not months.

about_pullquote: Good decorating is 90% prep and 10% paint. We do it properly.
about_para_1: South Gloss Decorating was founded on a simple principle: the best paint finish starts long before the brush hits the wall. Over twelve years, we've built a reputation across Bristol for meticulous surface preparation, colour advice you can trust, and reliable delivery. Every job, whether a single bedroom or a full commercial refurbishment, gets the same level of care.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we show up on time, we respect your home, and we don't cut corners. We source quality materials, we listen to what you want, and we'll tell you honestly if a job needs more prep work — even if it costs us time. That's earned us hundreds of repeat clients and referrals across South Bristol and beyond.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole of the downstairs decorated. The team were professional, tidy, and finished exactly when they said they would. Colour advice was spot on too. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We were nervous about getting the exterior done before winter, but South Gloss turned up, did a brilliant job, and we stayed dry all season. Thorough prep work made all the difference. Thanks lads.
reviews.author: Christine W.

reviews.text: Painted our kitchen cabinets and they look brand new. The finish is tough — been four months of heavy use and nothing's chipped or marked. Great value and real craftsmanship.
reviews.author: David M.
